notes: Pure 2025 public-API acceptance evidence for disjoint alternatives on one named HLAextendableVariantRecord. Two adapter-owned DIF modules declare the same named alternative with matching type and semantics but disjoint discriminant enumerators; each creates a federation alone and the pair creates one together. This directly witnesses the extendable-encoding addition behavior in IEEE 1516.2-2025 §4.14.8 and the selected Annex C.3 merge rule. The separate HLAvariantRecord conflict scenario rejects different alternative sets for the non-extendable case. This scenario itself does not claim that failure branch, private merged-catalog inspection, or all Table 40 constraints. The pinned page-110 candidate clips a following conflict sentence; page 111 supplies the remaining conflict and HLAother text (RL-319). Java provider runtime, interoperability, and conformance remain unverified.
